reviews.text: Highly recommended. Thank you Lenyn! The MGC team responded quickly when I reached out to them, and did a GREAT job fixing the 2 chimneys at my mother's house in Plains. I am in Allentown and Lenyn showed me the issues via video and photos.
reviews.author: Mike W.

reviews.text: Lenny and his crew did an outstanding job replacing my chimney. They are amazingly hard workers that get the job done perfectly and quickly. I can’t say enough about how happy we are with the work that they did. He gave me a fair price and a professional job.
reviews.author: Carl B.

reviews.text: After years of putting off chimney service, I finally contacted this company. Ben performed a careful chimney inspection and identified multiple concerns, including a damaged cap requiring chimney cap repair.
reviews.author: Blake S.
